messages:
Sam W.: heads up — after yesterday's KMS rotation some customers report SSO failures; refresh tokens appear to expire immediately for sessions minted before rotate. Anyone tracked root cause?

Tanya R.: :eyes: saw a couple in Sentry, 403 on /scim/v2/Users/deprovision. But also some OIDC introspects returning 401 invalid_token.

Jordan L.: FWIW key alias changed during rotate; tokens encrypted with old wrapping key might not be rewrapped. Logs show 'jwe unwrap failed: unsupported key id' in idp-service.

Sam W.: copying log snippet:
```
[2026-03-22T09:12:03Z] idp-service ERROR jwe: unwrap failed: kid=alias/redwood-prod-2026-03-21 code=KMS.DecryptFailed
[2026-03-22T09:12:03Z] scim-provisioner WARN deprov 403 user=acct-123 msg="KMS unwrap failed"
```

Lee H.: can you check kms:ListKeys + describeKey for alias propagation? sometimes alias change takes a few mins in cross-region replication.

Jordan L.: done — alias exists but the grant used by idp-service had the old key arn. Looks like RBAC for KMS grants didn't update in the rotation job.

Tanya R.: ah — so tokens can't be rewrapped and session cache still references old kid -> immediate expiry when we validate.

Sam W.: Proposed fix: update idp-service role to allow kms:Decrypt on new key arn, trigger background rewrap job to re-encrypt stored refresh tokens, and resume scim deprovs.

Lee H.: I can patch rotation playbook to also rotate the KMS grant and add a verification step: `aws kms get-key-policies` + test-decrypt roundtrip.

Jordan L.: Quick mitigation: enable fallback to verify tokens using legacy key if present (short-term) or rollback alias to previous key until grants updated.

Sam W.: who's oncall? @devsec-bot please page current oncall.

devsec-bot: paging @Lee H., @Jordan L. — incident 'idp.kms.unwrap' created: INC-2026-114

Tanya R.: I'll open CR to add tests in CI that detect stale grants after rotate.

Lee H.: running rewrap job on staging now: command:
```
python infra/scripts/rewrap_refresh_tokens.py --env staging --concurrency 10
```

Sam W.: after rewrap confirm scim deprov test passes:
```
curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/test/scim-deprov -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TESTTOKEN'
```

Jordan L.: test run shows green on staging, scim deprovs succeed, tokens validated. I'll coordinate prod window.

Sam W.: thanks. action items: Lee update rotation playbook + add validation step, Tanya add CI check, Jordan schedule prod rewrap during low traffic; Sam to draft post-incident note for compliance audit.

Tanya R.: :thumbsup:
